sentence: This project studies how a natural material that coats the lungs behaves at the boundary between water and oxygen-carrying liquids.
This project builds methods that help machine learning models for healthcare adapt as patient data changes over time.
This project studies how bipedal robots move on the Moon and uses reinforcement learning to design robust controllers.
This project tests whether bullfrog brains can run on ketone bodies instead of glucose during hibernation.
This project develops deep learning models that account for fairness as data streams change over time.
This project studies sound waves that act like quantum bits and tests whether they can store and process information.
This project studies how bacterial immune systems called retrons sense a phage infection and kill the infected cell.
This project builds statistical methods that reduce high-dimensional data to lower-dimensional representations while preserving its structure.
This project studies how polyploid cell growth after injury connects to the innate immune response in the fruit fly.
This project builds automated lab-on-a-chip devices that monitor and control the physiology of live cells over time.
This project acquires a mass spectrometer to study atmospheric chemistry, including how secondary organic aerosols form.
This project uses artificial intelligence and satellite remote sensing to map nitrogen and phosphorus in American rivers over time.
This project develops the hardware behind smart systems such as wearable devices and sensor networks.
This project designs alloys that recover their shape at high temperatures using machine learning and laboratory tests.
This project studies the problems that technologies aim to solve, using data mining and machine learning to help predict technology outcomes.
This project studies the genes and neurons that let a small crustacean keep an internal clock matched to the tides.
